title: Fit an adaptor bar across a countertop food warmer's well, then hang a quarter pan of macaroni and cheese on it
instruction: Seat the adaptor bar across the food warmer's well with both hands, then hang the 1/4-size steam table pan of macaroni and cheese in the far half of the well with one long edge on the bar and the other on the far rim, keeping the pan level.
context: Fast food and counter workers (about 3.9 million in the US) and dining room and cafeteria attendants replenish food at steam tables and serving stations as listed O*NET tasks, alongside restaurant cooks (about 1.4 million). A 1/4-size pan is only 162 mm wide and cannot span a full-size 305 mm well, so the order is fixed: the adaptor bar goes in first, then the loaded pan is hung with one edge on the bar and one on the far rim. The difficulty is keeping the bar seated and undisturbed while the pan's weight goes onto it, and carrying the pan level.
setup: Fixed on the floor (z = -0.0125 m) is a stainless equipment stand (762.0 x 1,219.0 x 610.0 mm, top at z = 0.5975 m spanning x 0.1300 to 0.8920 m and y -0.6095 to +0.6095 m). Fixed on the stand top, centred at (0.4800, 0.0000) m, is a dry, unheated stainless 12 x 20 in full-size countertop food warmer (Avantco W50 dimensions; black thermostat knob and amber lamp on the front) (368.3 x 571.5 x 228.6 mm outside; 304.8 x 508.0 x 158.75 mm inner well; 31.75 mm flat top rim at z = 0.8261 m). A loose flat stainless Vollrath 75020 adaptor bar (maker dimensions 1 x 20.907 x 0.313 in = 25.4 x 531.0 x 8.0 mm, 0.136 kg) lies flat on the stand top at (0.2130, 0.0000) m with its long axis along Y. One stainless 1/4-size steam table pan (hotel pan) (161.8 x 263.5 mm top, 63.5 mm deep, 2 mm sheet, 15 mm top flanges, 0.453 kg) holding a 12 mm layer of macaroni and cheese (0.28 kg; pan plus food 0.73 kg) stands upright on the stand top at (0.2130, +0.4675) m with its long side along Y. Two 6-DOF arms with parallel-jaw grippers are mounted at (0.0000, +0.3050, 0.7500) m and (0.0000, -0.3050, 0.7500) m. Everything is stock, off-the-shelf food-service equipment; no special facility is needed. For a real trial, use a sealed 0.28 kg food stand-in spread to a depth of 12 mm in the pan, so nothing can reach the grippers.
scoring: Judged from the trial video, a side photo along the well's long axis, a ruler and a phone level, over the final second of the trial. 1.0: the video shows the bar carried with both grippers closed on it, at least 25 mm above the stand top, for at least 0.5 s; the bar now rests across the well with both ends on the end rims, centred within 10 mm (ruler), level within 2 deg and within 5 deg of square to the well (phone level); the pan hangs in the far half of the well, level within 5 deg, with one long flange resting on the bar and the other on the far rim (no gap over 3 mm in the side photo, each flange overlapping its support by at least 5 mm, ruler) and its body inside the well. Either long flange may bear on the bar; turning the pan end-for-end does not change its score. Both grippers are at least 80 mm from the bar and the pan, and during the final second two marked points on each part (the two ends of the bar, the two short ends of the pan) stay within 3 mm of their starting locations. 0.5: everything for the bar as in 1.0, with the pan upright (level within 5 deg), resting on the stand top and not held, but not hung on the bar. 0.0 otherwise. Always 0.0 for the rest of the trial after any of these: either object falls off the stand or into the well; the pan tilts more than 15 deg at any time after it is first lifted 10 mm (exceeds the permitted carrying tilt); the bar, or the pan over the warmer, is let go with no gripper holding it more than 5 mm above its support (dropped or thrown); the bar slides more than 2 mm on the rims after release with nothing holding or resting on it (pushed into place); the bar stops resting on both rims after the pan is hung on it; the stand or warmer moves more than 2 mm or tilts more than 1 deg; full credit is reached and then lost.
reset_notes: No consumables. Return the bar flat to (0.2130, 0.0000) m along Y and the pan of food upright to (0.2130, +0.4675) m before each trial.
fidelity: Rigid-body PhysX at catalog sizes and masses, rendered as brushed stainless; knob, lamp, vents, feet and rolled edges are drawn only. The bar is a flat strip at the maker's listed size (its formed edges are not modelled), so a seated pan leans about 3 deg. The macaroni and cheese is a rigid block with drawn pasta; carrying tilt is limited instead of simulating spills. The warmer is dry and unheated. Stand and warmer fixed.
